sourceNote: PRIMARY MEASURED STUDY: the TCGplayer Authentication Center opened more than 8,000 Lost Origin packs (September 2022) and published per-pack rates. Their figures: Ultra Rare 19.95% overall, made up of normal V 11.63% (1 in 9), VMAX/VSTAR 4.42% (1 in 23), full-art V 1.98% (1 in 51), full-art Trainer 1.42% (1 in 70) and alt-art V 0.50% (1 in 201); Secret Rare 2.05% (1 in 49) split into rainbow 1.28% and gold 0.76%. Mapped onto this set's tiers by what each contains: double_rare = plain V (#27-146) = 11.63%; ultra_rare = plain VMAX/VSTAR plus the full-art/alt-art secret range (#166-196) = 19.95-11.63 = 8.32%; hyper_rare = the #197+ rainbow and gold range = 2.05%. The tiers sum to 22.00%, exactly TCGplayer's 19.95+2.05. KNOWN CONSERVATIVE GAP: their headline 32% hit rate also counts Trainer Gallery cards, which are a separate TG01-TG30 subset this catalog does not carry, so roughly 10 percentage points of pack contents are unmodelled and this set's EV is understated rather than inflated. Replaces a Sword & Shield era-generic estimate whose 4.2% hyper_rare was about double the measured 2.05%.
